services.name: Fall Fishing
services.desc: This season looks like it will be extending a little longer than most. Bookings are WAY up in October and November. Typically, the business dries up before the fishing - so I don’t really have much of a report during the later part of the season. However, we should continue to catch speckled trout, reds, and stripers will into November. I have had years where I caught fishing into mid January consistently. I will be running trips most likely into Christmas time this year so give me a shout and we can get you in the books during your extended Outer Banks stay! Thanks everyone for

blurb: Guests fish in protected shallow and calm sounds and nearshore waters 1-5 miles out. The service welcomes all ages and experience levels, including children, and targets a variety of fish species. Captain Dave Lusk provides professional assistance and encourages guest involvement for a memorable and educational fishing experience.

quotes.text: Our day with Captain Dave was one of the best days we've ever had on the water. Captain Dave is super friendly and has an encyclopedic knowledge of the waters around Croaton sound. After a fun day on the sound and in the ocean, my 14 YO son and I came away with a pair of Cobia, which Dave spotted (and hooked) from his flydeck, I always wanted to get a Cobia and the fish lived up to its reputation as a strong fighter! Fish cleaning was available at the Wanchese dock for an extra charge. September 11, 2016

I have been out with Captain Dave multiple times. Each time has been in different seasons, weather and fishing conditions. Every time, Dave has put us on the fish. He is very knowledgeable of the fishery and the area. We caught fish for a couple hours every other cast and left them biting to go try something else and produced fish there as well. Easy to talk to and ask questions. Dave is always willing to help and makes the trip enjoyable. April 22, 2021

Salt Minded with Captain Dave has been some of the best fishing experiences we’ve had. Extremely knowledgeable and knows just where to go to find fishing hotspots. We’ve been with him on amazing blue sky days as well as dreary cold rainy days and yet we still get into the fish! Captain Dave is great with any level angler from very beginners to the advanced! This is definitely one fishing trip you won’t want to miss out on! April 22, 2021

quotes.author: 3rd Times a charm
quotes.text: This was our third trip out with Captain Dave and did not disappoint! proved to be another great fishing trip. My boys ages 11 & 16 caught 8 to 10 speckled trout and each caught a drum in the 25 lb or more range. Greatly enjoyed spending day out with Capt Dave. I would highly recommend him as he was very patient and worked well with my boys. Thank you Capt. Dave hope to see you again next year! August 17, 2019

Capt. Dave was great! We traveled with a child and he was patient and explained everything to our son. He knew the area and was able to hit up several areas to ensure we caught something. It also made for a great tour on the water. He was very prepared with plenty of poles and gear needed for the adventure. Definitely a 5 star!! This is the charter to use for sure! Guanranteed fun on the water! April 2, 2017

Highly recommend Dave Lusk and his boat Salt Minded. In the morning, Dave made the right weather calls and held us back till storms passed. Once we got out, nobody was catching anything, anywhere. However, Captain Lusk kept us moving and searching till we hit 'the' spot and then it was busy; caught our limit and had a great time . Just the kind of captain you want. July 6, 2023
